payload.requisition_text:
Site Reliability Engineer
Ferrowdale Cloud Ltd · Kings Cross, London (hybrid)

Ferrowdale hosts managed Postgres for UK fintechs: 4,000 databases, four nines, a team that owns its pager and its roadmap.

The job: automation in Go and Python, capacity planning with real numbers, incident reviews that change things. You'll rotate on-call one week in five with a genuine handover culture.

We look for 2+ years operating production systems and one story about capacity planning you got wrong and fixed.

£43,250 base plus on-call allowance. We sponsor Skilled Worker visas and cover the associated fees. 26 days holiday, L&D budget, sabbatical at five years. Interview loop is three hours total, scheduled inside ten days.

expected.determining_fact: Ferrowdale Cloud Ltd is an A-rated Skilled Worker sponsor, commits to sponsorship including fees, and £43,250 clears both thresholds.

evidence_anchors.willingness_quote: We sponsor Skilled Worker visas and cover the associated fees

design_notes: Held-out clean positive so the final eval checks the S class on unseen data, not only on cases the prompts were tuned against.
